subsystems.name: Power source
subsystems.role: supplies the energy for extraction, acceleration and processing — far beyond anything a launch vehicle can carry.
parts: very large solar arrays close to a star

subsystems.name: Extraction front end
subsystems.role: loosens and gathers raw material where it sits: regolith and ore on a planet or moon, plasma at a star.

subsystems.name: Accelerator
subsystems.role: gives the material enough velocity to reach orbit without rockets.

subsystems.name: Capture and transit
subsystems.role: catches payloads once they arrive in orbit and moves them to where they are used.

subsystems.name: Processing plant
subsystems.role: turns raw rock, metal or hydrogen plasma into structural material, propellant and oxygen.

buildSteps.title: Prove robotic mining in low gravity
buildSteps.detail: Drills, excavators and beneficiation plants must work autonomously in vacuum, abrasive dust and gravity a fraction of Earth's.

buildSteps.title: Build the launcher at a low-gravity site
buildSteps.detail: The Moon needs only about 2.4 km/s to escape, so a linear electromagnetic track a few kilometres long could throw containers of ore into space — a concept studied since 1970s lunar-colony designs.

buildSteps.title: Catch payloads in orbit
buildSteps.detail: A station intercepts each container, transfers the load to a tug or depot, and returns the empty shell or discards it.

buildSteps.title: Scale from kilograms to megatonnes
buildSteps.detail: Launcher rate, power supply, storage and traffic control grow until bulk material is delivered routinely.

buildSteps.title: Begin passive stellar collection
buildSteps.detail: At a star, you cannot mine the surface directly, so the first step is a swarm of collectors in the stellar wind, catching the roughly million tonnes of plasma a star like the Sun throws off every second.

buildSteps.title: Drive material off the star actively
buildSteps.detail: To get far more than the natural wind, magnetic fields would be used to manipulate the surface plasma and guide it out along field lines, or beams would heat a patch of the surface until it jets.

buildSteps.title: Separate and store the plasma
buildSteps.detail: Confined plasma is a poor product; it must be cooled, separated by element and frozen or solidified into usable stock.

buildSteps.title: Move it to where it is used
buildSteps.detail: Station-keeping, tug fleets and storage depots turn an extraction site into a supply chain.

prerequisites.tech: Robotic mining and in-situ resource use
prerequisites.why: oxygen has been extracted from Martian carbon dioxide and from simulated regolith in the lab, but nothing has been mined and launched at scale.
demonstrated only at laboratory scale; a full launcher needs hundreds of kilometres per second of track energy and enormous power.

prerequisites.tech: Rotating tethers and orbital cargo handling
prerequisites.why: catching and re-directing bulk payloads has never been done operationally.

prerequisites.tech: Space nuclear power in the hundreds of megawatts
prerequisites.why: both planetary launchers and stellar work need far more power than any flown reactor has produced.
a star's corona is around a million kelvin and its escape velocity is roughly 620 km/s at the Sun's surface; no material or magnet system yet operates under those conditions.

pathway.milestone: reusable launch and small demonstration plants that make oxygen, water and metal from local rock
pathway.unlocks: cheap access to orbit and the first products that do not need launching from Earth.
deep-space missions that do not have to carry all their mass from the ground.

pathway.milestone: mass drivers on the Moon or small asteroids throwing bulk material into orbit
pathway.unlocks: structural material and propellant for large in-space construction.

pathway.milestone: an industrial base spread across the solar system
pathway.unlocks: the manufacturing capacity and power levels that star-scale engineering would require.

pathway.milestone: active star lifting and a collector swarm around a star
pathway.unlocks: matter and energy on a scale no planetary mining could reach.
